Amazon & Apple Both Report Earnings | The Close 7/30/2026 [...] Gil Luria, M12 Managing Partner Cheryl Cheng, Asymco Founder Horace Dediu, T. Rowe Price Science & Technology Equity Strategy Portfolio Manager Tony Wang, IDC Senior Director, Data & Analytics Nabila Popal, & Spencer Stuart Chair, Global CEO Practice Jim Citrin.

Apple reported third-quarter sales and profits that topped analysts’ estimates.

The company said its fiscal third-quarter revenue jumped 16% year-over-year to $109.4 billion, ahead of the $108.2 billion analysts expected. Earnings per share, at $2.02, beat the Street consensus compiled by Visible Alpha of $1.87. [...] Apple also beat Street estimates on the top and bottom lines. The company, which recently touched the $5 trillion market cap level, has the best-performing Magnificent 7 stock of the year by a good margin, up roughly 23% in 2026 through Thursday’s close.

Our previews of the results from Amazon and Apple were here and here, respectively. After today, investor attention will largely turn to Nvidia (NVDA), which is due to report in late August. [...] Apple said its gross margin, which came in at 50.1%, above the Street’s estimate near 48%, got a roughly 2 percentage-point lift from tariff refunds.

Earnings per share were also 5% higher, benefitting to the tune of $0.11 from refunds for tariffs that were struck down by the Supreme Court earlier this year.

—Kara Greenberg
